sentences.text: A vendor hawks miniature flags at two dollars apiece while the high school band tunes up behind the fire station. "That one's a Stuart," the old gunner told his granddaughter, "and I rode one just like it across Belgium." Ninety-one and ramrod straight, the parade marshal refused the golf cart and walked every block of the route. Next year they'll widen the route, the mayor promises, so the half-tracks won't have to squeeze past parked cruisers on Oak. You could feel the tracks through the sidewalk before the vehicle ever rounded the corner by the pharmacy. Did you see the turret swing toward the courthouse when the crew waved at the mayor? Behind the drum line, a lone bagpiper played while names were read aloud at the memorial fountain. Diesel smoke drifted over the funnel-cake stand, mixing with powdered sugar until the whole block smelled like 1944 at a county fair. Its Continental radial engine backfired twice near the reviewing stand, startling a pair of police horses. Steel treads chewed the fresh asphalt on Elm, leaving herringbone scars the city council would grumble about for weeks. According to the program, the M4 on display was pulled from a Normandy field in 1998 and restored by volunteers over eleven years. Rain threatened all morning, but by the time the armored column reached Third Street the sun broke through above the courthouse elms. A Korean War nurse rode in the lead convertible, waving a gloved hand at people who were not yet born when she shipped out. Members of VFW Post 214 led the procession down Main Street, trailed by a color guard and two armored personnel carriers on loan from the museum. Copper sulfate concentrations must be verified twice daily with a calibrated test kit before any additional dosing occurs. "Count the white spots for me," the vet said, "and tell me whether they've spread past the gill covers." Fin rot rarely reverses without pristine water; test ammonia daily, because medication breaks down and fouls a small volume fast. One level scoop of kanamycin per five gallons, added right after the fifty-percent water change — never guess the volume. Six days into the ich protocol and the spots are finally dropping off the tetras, though the water smells faintly of salt. Observation note, 21:40 — the discus took two bloodworms, first food accepted since transfer to the ten-gallon hospital setup. What is the meaning of the word tank?
